decisions.decision: Did NOT drop the WGAN-CNN seed-42 outlier
decisions.rationale: User asked if dropping it would 'fix everything'. Computation showed dropping it cleans up headline ranges (WGAN cluster mean 0.331 -> 0.110) and improves max |d| (2.34 -> 3.44), but does NOT improve the Bonferroni-corrected family-wise p (floor pair doesn't involve wgan_cnn). More importantly, post-hoc outlier removal without a pre-registered exclusion criterion is textbook p-hacking — would create a worse hostile-reviewer attack than the outlier itself. Chose robustness-check disclosure pattern instead.
